title: Keep Review changes focused on the diff

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught (on the empty-comparison paths: landed run with an empty captured comparison, snapshot "All changes" with no changes, and Commits selections that changed nothing).

Next proof action: none needed for the "offered when the comparison has files" promise on those paths. Optional gap: the literal Key example "Evidence gap while collapsed" (no captured comparison, review kind `landing-unavailable`) was not reached by this fault, because `reviewListsFiles` still gates on kind `landed`/`published`; a fault that offers the toggle for `landing-unavailable` would need its own probe. Its maintained assertion (one-shot-unavailable.spec.ts:64-66, uncaptured variant) exists and passed in all three runs.

Prior disposition: the caller noted the work rewrote, and in one place removed, assertions for this promise. The probe shows the rewritten assertions still catch this fault. It makes no new repair decision.

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-384-keep-review-changes-focused-on-the-diff.md#keep-review-changes-focused-on-the-diff, plan .planning/slice-plans/695-keep-review-changes-focused-on-the-diff/PLAN.md, at 3a703141f44d98968d20996da1abfeaedda68de4. Promise: Scope > File sidebar toggle "offered when the comparison has files"; Key example "Evidence gap while collapsed" (... no sidebar toggle is offered).

Fault (the caller's suggestion was used after checking it against the revision): dashboard/src/StoryReviewToolbar.tsx `reviewListsFiles` was changed in two places. For snapshot it returned `comparison !== undefined`, dropping `&& comparison.files.length > 0`. For landed/published it returned on kind alone, dropping `&& review.files.length > 0`. No fixture or assertion was changed.

Scratch checkout: detached worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/e4a75412/tmp/coverage at 3a703141f. Setup was `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm|browser|check`, and all three exited 0. Pre-probe `git status --short` was empty.

Command for every run: `OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_PROOF_RECORD=<file> caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:e2e -- e2e/review/story-review-one-shot-unavailable.spec.ts e2e/review/story-review-nothing.spec.ts e2e/review/story-review-commits.spec.ts`

Runs:
- Baseline: exit 0. The proof record shows selectedCount 12, phase completed, and 12/12 expected.
- Fault: exit 1. 12 tests ran: 4 unexpected and 8 expected. The catching assertions:
  - story-review-one-shot-unavailable.spec.ts:64-66, "a valid empty captured comparison says the delivered run changed nothing": `getByRole('button', {name: /^(Hide|Show) files$/})` toHaveCount(0) received 1.
  - story-review-nothing.spec.ts:82, "a worktree straight off trunk has no changes against the named baseline": `filesToggle(review)` toHaveCount(0) received 1.
  - story-review-commits.spec.ts:145, "a clean merge selected alone changed nothing by itself": `filesToggle` count 0 received 1.
  - story-review-commits.spec.ts:199, "an empty plain commit names its range and lists no files": `filesToggle` count 0 received 1.
- Restored: exit 0. selectedCount 12, 12/12 expected.

Reach and wrong behavior: each failing test first passed its own earlier no-files checks. Those checks were the review list count 0, "empty delivered comparison" / "No changes" / "changed nothing" text, and changedFilesList count 0. So each test was on the empty-comparison path. Playwright's call log then resolved a "Hide files" button inside the Review toolbar group 13-14 times ("locator resolved to 1 element"). That is a toggle offered with nothing to hide, which is the promised behavior going wrong. The uncaptured evidence-gap test (kind landing-unavailable) passed under the fault, consistent with the fault not reaching that kind.

Restoration: an EXIT trap ran `git checkout -- dashboard/src/StoryReviewToolbar.tsx`. Afterwards `git status --short` was empty and HEAD was still 3a703141f, matching the pre-probe state, and the restored rerun passed 12/12. The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove --force` (rc 0). The directory is gone and `git worktree list` no longer lists it.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, wall-clock seconds around each focused npm command via `date +%s`. Baseline 47 s, fault 52 s, restored 37 s, total 136 s. The machine was shared and loaded.
- Human effort: unavailable. There was no human interaction during the probe, and no separate measure exists.
- Agent effort: unavailable as tokens. There is no supported token or cost meter in this session. Estimated at about 10 tool calls (count of this agent's tool operations, estimated).
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 222041 ms (measured), from 1794997001000 to 1794997223041 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 3a703141f44d98968d20996da1abfeaedda68de4; verdict Caught; no follow-up.
